paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 2.55, with a change of -3.77% compared to the prior close and -43.96% over a window of 22 sessions. The price is as of October 23, 2026.

These headlines are from Yahoo Finance and were published on October 24 and October 13, 2026.

There have been recent SEC filings, including a Form 4 on October 22, 2026, and a Form 144 on October 20, 2026. An 8-K filing was also made on October 16, 2026, announcing an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd.
